source.note: Kenney suv (FBX like car-sedan, car-taxi and car-police from the same kit and pin; the plan named the GLB member, which references Textures/colormap.png). Same scale as car-sedan: both are 1.3 units tall in the source, so the SUV also gets 1.45 m, which makes it 3.01 m long and 1.67 m wide (the sedan is 2.84 m long); stylized toy proportions (a real compact SUV is about 4.4 x 1.8 x 1.7 m). Kenney's green body is recoloured to the indigo script's navy (a colour no other library car uses), with the grey roof and rims in paper white, the grey rear quarter, grille and wheel-arch flares in near-black like tinted glass and trim, headlights in the amber practical. Wheels are separate nodes in the source; static, no clips.
